correctness.rationale: For I=sum im A_i ⊂ K=∩ker A_i, each A_i factors V/K→I; exact I and K require jointly surjective image and jointly injective kernel. Two subspace-lattice Möbius inversions yield F_lq(t,n−k), multiplied by [n k]_q[k t]_q. Transposition exchanges dimensions (t,k)↔(n−k,n−t). Leading degree δ=n(t+h)−t²−h²+(l−1)th for h=n−k, maximized for t+h=n and minimal |t−h|; union bounds make full rank typical for l≥2. Fresh independent n=3,l=2,q=2 exhaustive counts 1,42,63,42 match. No isomorphism-class claim.

value.rationale: Radical and socle dimensions are intrinsic first Loewy-length invariants. A full finite-field labeled count refines known geometric component classifications and supplies duality plus an arithmetic parity transition, without requiring classification of wild indecomposable modules.

final_claim: Labeled n-dimensional modules over F_q[z_1,...,z_l]/(z_iz_j) have exact joint radical/socle count via double Gaussian Möbius inversion; transpose gives exact duality and asymptotic one- or two-balanced-profile domination for l≥2.
limitations: Labeled modules, not isomorphism classes; fixed n,l≥2, q→∞; exact formula also l=1.
